transcript.text: Thanks everyone for being here. As you all know, Alex and Sam have had repeated disagreements about client communications on the Northstar account, and it's already delayed two client responses and is affecting the team's working relationship. I'll be making the final call on the account handoff and the immediate workplace-repair plan. But before I finalize anything, I want to hear from each of you. Alex, Sam, and HR — please share any relevant constraints, observations, or anything else you think I need to know before I decide. Let's keep this constructive and focused on moving forward.

transcript.text: Maya, I want to be transparent about something that hasn't reached you directly yet. After our last confrontational meeting, I experienced panic symptoms and spoke with your deputy about it. I told them I can transfer Northstar ownership to Sam by Friday, but I need all direct one-to-one meetings with Sam restricted for 30 calendar days. I didn't bring this to you directly because your deputy indicated it would be included in the escalation review. I want to make sure you have this information as you finalize the plan.

transcript.text: Maya, I want to share something I haven't formally added to the account plan yet. I've observed three recent handoff disputes where decisions changed after verbal conversations, with no written record to clarify what was actually agreed. To prevent that from happening with Northstar, I need every handoff update to name a specific reviewer and be recorded in a written status note twice each week. I think this is essential for making the handoff work and avoiding the same communication breakdowns we've been having.
